name: PasteCellsToExcelWorksheet
label: Paste Range Cells to Excel Worksheet
description: Pastes a range of cells from a source worksheet to a specified range or named area in a target worksheet.

fields.name: SourceWorksheet
fields.label: Source Worksheet Instance
fields.description: The source Excel worksheet containing the range to copy.

fields.name: TargetWorksheet
fields.label: Target Worksheet Instance
fields.description: The target Excel worksheet where the data will be pasted.

fields.name: SourceRangeAddress
fields.label: Source Range Address
fields.description: The range address (e.g., 'A1:B10') in the source worksheet to copy.

fields.name: PasteMode
fields.label: Paste Mode
fields.description: Specifies how to determine the paste location.

selectOptions.label: On Named Cells
selectOptions.description: Pastes data into a named range.

selectOptions.label: On Currently Active Cell
selectOptions.description: Pastes data starting from the currently active cell.

selectOptions.label: On Specified Cell
selectOptions.description: Pastes data starting from a specific column and row.

fields.name: Name
fields.label: Name
fields.description: The name of the named range to paste into (required if 'Paste Mode' is 'On Named Cells').

fields.name: Column
fields.label: Column
fields.description: The column letter (e.g., 'A', 'B') where the paste should begin (required if 'Paste Mode' is 'On Specified Cell').

fields.name: Row
fields.label: Row
fields.description: The row number where the paste should begin (required if 'Paste Mode' is 'On Specified Cell').
